findings.title: Parse the real prefixed birth-event grammar instead of rejecting every real launch
findings.evidence: Facts::parse requires raw.starts_with("kind=birth"). The actual fixture log_event prefixes all returned lines with `wpn-ev seq=<N> ` before appending `kind=birth ...`. Lua preserves the whole e.raw unchanged in its birth row. Therefore every actual healthy launched birth is rejected as not its weapon's birth line. The synthetic and scripted-engine birth fixtures omit this real prefix, so their guards cannot catch the incompatibility.
findings.requested_change: Validate the actual tokenized event grammar, including birth kind and matching weapon identity, while retaining full original raw birth lines for equivalent-launch comparison. Update bookkeeping fixtures to include real `wpn-ev seq=...` lines and explicitly reject malformed prefixes/kinds/identities. No production change or golden rewrite is needed.
findings.evidence_class: Deterministic source/actual-serializer mismatch; no reviewer execution.

findings.title: Establish that the frozen cohort is complete and registered before treating its terminals as authority evidence
findings.evidence: The driver writes case_launch.births=#members from the rows it happened to receive; the judge compares that same derived count to the same cohort list. Neither validates it against the C launch report's independent births/creates counts or existing log/track-overflow status. The fixture can drop events once its finite log is full, emit kind=truncated, and emit w=-1 when track allocation fails. The driver accepts any tonumber(w), including -1, and the judge accepts finite negative terminal steps/distance/max_velocity plus a zero hexadecimal track. An unregistered sentinel can consequently stand for a cohort member or a partial observed launch for the full cohort. Event truncation/overflow is not a new hypothetical API: the existing fixture explicitly records it for comparators to refuse.
findings.requested_change: Require positive integral registered weapon identities; reject truncated/overflowed evidence using existing fixture/report information; compare frozen birth cardinality with the actual launch report before arming. Do not infer completeness solely from duplicate copies of observed-row counts. Extend the finite bookkeeping controls for dropped/truncated births and sentinel identity; no new physics, world trace or census framework is needed.
findings.evidence_class: Source-supported false-positive evidence path; not observed in the current retail runs, which remain Root's gate.

inspected_facts: Driver delegates the real environment provider until the healthy launch call and immediate event drain complete, freezes identities/birth strings, then arms before another frame. It never changes the request table. Armed wind vector answers alone are altered; speed-only wind and other operations delegate unchanged. Changed values are finite exact singles (64,64,0,0) and recorded before reply/refusal.

Changed-wind judgement matches configuration, selection, full launch text/frame, cohort identities and full initial birth strings. It requires whole-cohort terminal cardinality, actual recorded vector traffic, every armed vector question altered, exact sent constants, changed complete flight facts, no changed member farther -x and at least one farther +x. No all-state/RNG/policy equivalence is established or claimed.

Refusal judgement requires a matched healthy launch, an armed sent vector alteration and the specific wind.callback or wind.answer marker, rejecting process/witness failures and healthy non-refusals. Lua clock stalls/budget exhaustion are hard witness failures; evidence-file write/flush/close errors propagate even after the authority row. Public runner requires process success and strict readable JSON before judgement.

Driver keeps later births and foreign terminals separate, records duplicate case terminals and requires one complete ten-field terminal per cohort member through the judge. Witness remains bounded to recorded cohort facts; global provider vector traffic is explicitly disclosed rather than attributed exclusively to that projectile.

Synthetic rows and scripted Lua collaborators are explicitly bookkeeping tests, not physics or public product proof. Missing executable/root configuration prints SKIPPED with product path NOT exercised. Actual fresh verified roots, DLL identity and all five public modes remain Root's gates; the harness itself does not verify retail manifests or canonical root uniqueness.

run_bounded drains child pipes while running, enforces a per-child wall cap and reports exit/error context. Public Windows mode processes use CREATE_NO_WINDOW. Existing standalone child controls test hanging and failing children. No unrelated process framework was added.

Git delta contains new test witness/docs/receipts only; no production C/Rust provider/ABI/boot/build/manifest change. Root's separate byte-equivalence audit remains its evidence, not a new production review here.
